Operator decision on TASK-2631 (recorded on the spec): Claude stays fully AIDA-contained; Codex runs its native workspace-write sandbox by explicit per-vendor opt-in, `[contained.vendors] codex = "native"`, reported everywhere as "native, not AIDA-contained", until STORY-2238 lands. AC2 is replaced; see the latest comment. It stays within BUG-2144's ruling: explicit, not silent.

Request: promote TASK-2631 to approved ahead of the other drafts. The operator wants a Codex implementer to build it and is launching one now (outside `aida agent new`, since this bug blocks that path). Strict review, please: it touches launch posture.
subject: Promote TASK-2631 now: operator decision recorded, Codex implementer launching
